rules.gain: Only recorded qualifying event, at most 1 resonance per owned spell instance per poker hand
rules.branch_offer: At threshold after settlement; deterministic choice persists; replaces one specific spell instance 1-to-1
rules.evolved_ability: Inherit existing one-cast-per-hand ceiling; max aether 3; evolving not allowed during hand; target legality enforced
rules.tracking: Resonance on instance-id not spell-id, so duplicated spells do not level together

evolutions.resonance_event: Cast legally and target remains eligible through next completed betting action

branches.name: Twin Oracle
branches.timing_window: Own decision on any betting street
branches.target: 1 or 2 distinct nonfolded opponents with concealed hole cards
branches.public_tell_text: Two violet eyes turn toward the wagerers.
branches.effect: Reveal exactly one random hole card from each chosen opponent privately to caster; if only one eligible target, reveal one from that target. Publicly disclose identities of targeted seats only.

branches.name: Ravenous Eye
branches.timing_window: Own decision on any betting street
branches.target: One nonfolded opponent with concealed hole cards
branches.public_tell_text: The eye opens fully and consumes its sigil.
branches.effect: Reveal both target hole cards privately to caster; after cast this spell instance exhausts until the table ends. No shared disclosure.

evolutions.resonance_event: The enchanted raise is legally matched or exceeded by another seat after cast

branches.name: Ember Echo
branches.timing_window: Own poker action immediately before legal raise; atomic cast+raise
branches.public_tell_text: The raised wager echoes like a struck bell.
branches.effect: Use base Cinder qualifying rules, plus on a sole contested showdown win with a qualifying matcher, draw one additional magic card at the start of the next poker hand (max 4 drawn). The Aether gain stays +2, capped at 3. All fold remains +1. Exactly one next-hand draw marker.

branches.name: Red Oath
branches.timing_window: Own poker action immediately before legal raise; atomic cast+raise
branches.public_tell_text: The caster stakes a visible sigil on the raise.
branches.effect: Publicly reveal one randomly selected current hole card of the caster on cast; matched sole contested showdown victory grants +1 Aether instead of +2; all fold grants +1; base Cinder eligibility rules otherwise apply. Reveal remains current if any subsequent legal hole-card exchange occurs.

evolutions.resonance_event: After legal cast, at least one voluntary betting action occurs under its pot-limit restriction

branches.name: Thorn Lattice
branches.target: All live seats, current and next street (if next street exists)
branches.public_tell_text: Thorns spread toward the next street.
branches.effect: Apply pot-limit this street and automatically at start of next street before any voluntary action, unless hand ends. Identical caps for all seats. If cast on river, current street only.

branches.name: Quiet Briars
branches.public_tell_text: The thorns drink the sound of wagers.
branches.effect: Apply base Briar Lock. If no voluntary raise or bet occurs during the locked street, refund 1 Aether at street end (capped at 3, once per cast). Checks do not count as bets; earlier blinds do not count.

evolutions.resonance_event: Legal exchange is completed and caster survives to flop or hand ends by all-fold preflop

branches.name: Second Reflection
branches.timing_window: Preflop opening magic window before voluntary bet
branches.public_tell_text: Two reflections hover above a face-down card.
branches.effect: Draw two distinct random candidates without replacement from undealt stub, choose one as replacement; return other candidate and original removed card to stub only after selection, then reshuffle. No other hole/board/burn card modified. Choice private.

branches.name: Marked Fate
branches.timing_window: Preflop opening magic window before voluntary bet
branches.public_tell_text: The discarded rank is inscribed on the Ledger.
branches.effect: Execute base Fate Exchange, but publicly announce the rank (not suit) of the discarded card after replacement. Current replacement remains private. No duplicate cards.
